svg.title: Standard beam load cases with bending moment and deflection formulas
svg.text: Beams – six standard load cases: support, load, deflected shape (red dashed), bending moment diagram, formulas
Linear-elastic, small deflection, constant E·I. F in N, q in N/mm, L in mm, E in N/mm² (steel 210 000), I in mm⁴ → f in mm. Sagging moment (+) drawn below the line.
1 Simply supported – point load F at centre
3 Cantilever – point load F at free end
5 Both ends fixed – point load F at centre
= 1/4 of case 1 – fixing ends is stiff
6 Both ends fixed – uniform load q
Worked example (case 1): IPE 200 (I = 1943 cm⁴, W = 194 cm³), L = 3 m, F = 10 kN at centre, S235:
Deflection limits (orientation): steel structures L/250 – L/300; machine frames and bases L/1000 – L/5000 (stiffness, not strength, decides).
Superposition: for several loads add the deflections of each case at the same point (linear).
